meta.domain: monochromator + energy calibration (HEM Si(111) Laue, foil K-edge E_scan/Emon, drift)
meta.source: kb_1ID/kb.sqlite (startup/tables cited doc_id:line; user logs only as 'user log <year>'), blade.physics.core, xraydb 4.5.8
meta.conventions: energies keV unless the key says eV; off_eV = HEM readback at the true edge minus nominal xraydb edge (negative = readback low); th1_err_mdeg = (true Th1 offset) - (offset set in userTran3) = -off_eV/|dE/dTh1|, positive = readback low
meta.fit_scripts: reproducible from the KB with the procedure in fits/mono.md (scripts were run from /tmp and are not part of the repo)

edge_offset.definition: off_eV = HEM readback energy at which the foil K edge is found (E_scan fit 'pos') minus the xraydb edge energy. th1_err_mdeg = -off_eV/|dE/dTh1| = (true Th1 offset) - (offset set in userTran3); positive = readback low.

emon_inversion.model: mu_t(E) = b + (b/2)*erf((E - pos - bias)/wid) at the HEM readback E; inverse gives the readback energy of the edge-equivalent point
emon_inversion.note: compared with E_scan 'pos' of the same session (same element, +-1 day); the operators' target ut equals b, not the erf mid-level dif+b/2 (Emon calc record has a ~0.1-0.2 zero offset relative to E_scan units)

drift_fixed_energy.note: consecutive Emon readings at unchanged E_hem in one session; sign is random (mean ~0), so modelled as a random walk; includes unknown dumps and Th2 tweaks (Emon-after-tweak pairs excluded because E_hem changes)

Pr.note: no E_scan fit; b = operator target ut=1.0 (Emon mu_t 1.01-1.07 at the calibrated energy, 2026); dif assumed 0.6 b

foils.model: mu_t step across the K edge b = (mu_above - mu_below)[xraydb, edge+-0.05 keV, elemental density] * t_eff;  dif (pre-edge mu_t of the E_scan fit) ~ 0.60*b (0.54-0.64) because the calc record carries a ~0.3 offset on top of mu_below*t
foils.note: t_eff is the thickness that reproduces b with xraydb Delta-mu; it absorbs table error (white line/EXAFS/harmonic leakage) so treat as +-10 % absolute; relative b scatter between logs is 0.3-2 %

edge_width.definition: E_scan erf width: mu_t = dif + b*(1+erf((E-pos)/wid))/2; wid in eV; derivative FWHM = 1.665*wid

M0_single_term.note: sim currently uses dtheta=23 urad; rms with 23 = 4.16 eV

M1_natural_plus_theta.form: Voigt: Lorentz FWHM = xraydb core_width(K) [fixed], Gaussian sigma_E = E*cot(theta_B)*dtheta; wid = 1/(sqrt(pi)*Voigt(0))

M3_natural_plus_theta_plus_floor.form: as M1 with sigma_E^2 = (E cot dtheta)^2 + sigma0^2

edge_width.identifiability: NOT separable: the free-natural-width-scale fit collapses to dtheta=0 with scale ~1.6 (rms 3.4 eV) -- the natural K-hole width (~Z^4) and the angular term E*cot(theta) (~E^2) rise together over 42-90 keV; rms stays 3.4-4.1 eV for all admissible splits. Per-scan repeatability of Re wid is 1.3 eV (n=17), so the residual 3-4 eV is model error (white line, thickness, harmonics).
edge_width.slit_dependence: no dependence of Re wid (55-61 eV) on WB slit size 0.3-0.6 mm where the slit is logged (association by proximity, weak)

th2_rocking.two_crystal_factor_note: indicative autocorrelation broadening of two parallel Darwin curves (non-dispersive +,-); not from the logs

log_evidence.item: flux 520 -> 562 kHz (x1.081) after a Th2 retune at 200 mA
log_evidence.use: Gaussian: I/Ipk=0.925 => offset = 0.169*FWHM before the retune

log_evidence.item: cold start flux 225 -> 430 kHz (x1.91) after Th2 + gap re-tweak; then 430 -> 426 kHz (-0.9 %) 'thermalization'
one Th2 'tweak up' moved Re mu_t 1.299 -> 1.334 (+2.7 eV at the edge)
log_evidence.use: with sim coupling 0.3 and 45 eV/mdeg at 71.7 keV => 0.2 mdeg = one 0.0002 deg step

log_evidence.item: Th1 and Th2 walked together in 0.0001-0.0002 deg steps for energy: one 0.0001 deg step moved Re mu_t 1.53 -> 1.459
log_evidence.use: checks dE/dTh (4.5 eV per 0.0001 deg) x slope b/(sqrt(pi) wid)=13.2 /keV => -0.059 predicted vs -0.071 logged

log_evidence.item: Th2 offset relative to Th1 drifted +31 mdeg between Jul 15 and Sep 11 2026 (Th1 +5 mdeg, Th2 +36 mdeg)
log_evidence.use: routine retunes track a drift much larger than any plausible rocking width

bounds_fwhm_mdeg.note: log_based range is conditional: lower = at least one 0.1 mdeg step needed to gain 8 % (offset 0.169 FWHM); upper = retunes of 1-5 steps of 0.2 mdeg. NOT identifiable without a Th2 scan; the sim's 2 mdeg lies inside the log-based range and ~7x above the physical Darwin prior.

heat_load.fit: dT = k * (WB width x height) ; k fitted to two points (2 points, 1 parameter: 0.2 K residuals); crystal at ~83-86 K (cryo), same session, same energy
heat_load.lattice_expansion_note: INFERRED: Si thermal expansion near 85 K is ~ -0.4e-6 /K (zero crossing 124 K), so dT=10 K shifts E by ~0.3 eV at 71.7 keV -- orders below the 5-12 eV post-dump shifts; the dump/thermal energy shifts must come from slope error/bending or mount drift, not from lattice expansion

events.flux: -7 % right after return, -3 % after E + Th2 retune

events.what: Pr, recovery from dump 2026-09-16/17, Th2 re-tweaked
Re, cold start after overnight (new HEM) 2026-07-08
events.flux: B3 225 -> 430 kHz after Th2+gap tweak, then slow decay to 426 kHz

dump_events.note: energy shifts at a dump are 2-12 eV (0.05-0.3 mdeg Th1 equivalent) with random sign; flux loss 3-7 %. A relaxation time cannot be fitted: no time-resolved series after a dump exists (the shortest same-E pairs, 4-7 min apart, were not after a dump and differ by <1 eV).

escan_timing.note: 'Estimated duration' printed by E_scan; 539.85-387.35=152.5 s and 387.35-196.85=190.5 s (the scan window/step/count time were reduced); Emon takes ~5 s count plus foil move; calibrate_energy in the sim should use these.

recommended.note: signed, true offset minus set offset; replaces the assumed 0.5 mdeg; 1.2 (reconciliation note) is the rms-about-zero scale of the same data. Use mean 0.2 / sd 0.22 for a 'freshly referenced' (post Jul-2026) state and 17 mdeg only for a re-referenced Th zero.

table.prov: fit of three Th1 values (2.684/2.089/1.748 deg at 51.81/71.15/90.52 keV), 2023-startup_jan23_explog screenshots via 01_source_and_monochromator.md

derived: Th1=1.2477 at E_hem=71.676 keV, 2026-techcomm_jun26_explog:554,518 (re-referenced Th zero, 08_open_questions item 8)

reset_2026.note: the Th zero was re-referenced between Jul 7 and Jul 15 2026 (offset +0.04 -> -0.33 deg); the Bragg model Th = theta_B + offset still holds afterwards with the new offset (consistent at 71.676 keV only: a single energy). Sep 2026 log: 'new HEM Th values (should use a new reference for energy control)'.

si111_check_2023.eps_note: free d-scale fits exactly (3 points, quoted to 0.001 deg => eps uncertainty ~ +-6e-4); consistent with zero: Si(111) d=3.1356 A at room temperature holds to <0.1 %
